title: Controlled immobilization of single-domain antibodies using cellulose-binding modules for AB5-type toxin detection in paper-based assays
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21423-21437

Selma B. Belfakir, Jonas A. Jürgensen, Marcus Petersson, Max Stæhr Wraae, Patrick Munk, Suthimon Thumtecho, Mateus G. Masteghin, Anne Ljungars, Andreas H. Laustsen, Sandra W. Thrane, Georgina M. S. Ross
A single-domain antibody (VHH)-based sandwich-format lateral flow assay was developed for the detection of cholera toxin from V. cholerae and heat-labile enterotoxin from enterotoxigenic E. coli in human fecal and environmental water samples.
